machine_details.machine_type: High Temperature High Pressure Rope Dyeing Machine

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: Cotton knits, Polyester knits & wovens, Polyamide, Viscose, T/C Blends
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Disperse Dyes, Acid Dyes, Direct Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Salt, Soda Ash, Caustic Soda, Hydros, Acetic Acid, Leveling Agents
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Scouring, Bleaching, Exhaust Dyeing, Soaping, Reduction Clearing, Softening

machine_constraints.maximum_load: 300 kg (Overloading >320 kg causes turn time >120s and severe rope marks)
machine_constraints.minimum_load: 150 kg (Underloading <120 kg alters liquor ratio and causes liquor foaming)
machine_constraints.temperature_restrictions: Do not exceed 135°C for elastomeric Lycra blends to avoid heat damage
machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Main safety valve trips at 4.2 bar
machine_constraints.chemical_restrictions: Strictly prohibit Sodium Hypochlorite or free Chlorine (corrodes 316L stainless steel)
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Not suitable for delicate silk satins or ultra-high tension sensitive wovens

performance.water_consumption: 35 to 50 Liters per kg of fabric processed (total process water)
performance.steam_consumption: 2.8 to 3.5 kg steam per kg of fabric
performance.power_consumption: 18.5 kW main pump motor + 5.5 kW winch reel motor

sensors.pressure_sensor: Piezo-resistive Vessel Pressure Transmitter (0 to 6 bar)
sensors.ph_sensor: In-line Industrial Gel-filled Glass Electrode pH Sensor (pH 0-14)
sensors.level_sensor: Differential Pressure Hydrostatic Level Transmitter (0-100% tank volume)

operating_parameters.recommended_temperature: 60°C for Reactive Dyeing | 130°C for Disperse Dyeing
operating_parameters.recommended_speed: 250 to 350 m/min winch reel speed (Turn time 50 to 75 seconds)

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect main pump shaft seal, clean lint filter basket, check pneumatic door seal
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect heat exchanger steam traps, calibrate pH electrode, check reel belt tension
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate PT100 temp sensors, inspect safety burst disc, check main valve actuators
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Quarterly calibration of PT100 sensors and pressure transmitters with certified calibrator

failure_information.common_faults: Rope entanglement/tangle, high differential pressure across filter, steam trap waterlog
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Turn time > 120s, Temp deviation > ±2°C, Vessel pressure > 3.8 bar, Door safety open
failure_information.failure_causes: Fabric knot formation, clogged filter screen, steam supply pressure drop < 5 bar
failure_information.troubleshooting: Reverse winch reel manually; flush filter basket; verify boiler steam pressure

safety.safety_limits: Max temp 140°C, Max pressure 4.0 bar, Door opening temp limit < 80°C
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Vessel overpressure > 4.1 bar, main circulation pump dry-run, power outage
safety.ppe_requirements: Heat-resistant gloves, safety goggles, steel-toe boots, ear protection

machine_operating_rules: IF fabric_type == 'Polyester' THEN max_temperature = 130°C AND min_pressure = 2.8 bar
IF fabric_type == 'Cotton' THEN max_temperature = 98°C AND pressure = 0.0 bar
IF fabric_gsm < 150 THEN max_nozzle_pressure = 0.5 bar (prevent pilling)
interlock_conditions: Pneumatic door lock MUST remain ENGAGED while Vessel_Temperature > 80°C OR Vessel_Pressure > 0.2 bar
Heating valve MUST CLOSE if Main_Pump_Flow < 200 L/min (dry run prevention)
decision_rules: REJECT recipe IF liquor_ratio < 1:5 OR liquor_ratio > 1:10
FLAG WARNING IF heating_rate > 1.5°C/min between 90°C and 130°C on Polyester
best_operating_practices: Perform hot drain at 80°C after disperse dyeing to keep oligomers in emulsion state
Dose alkali exponentially over 30 min for reactive dyes to prevent strike unlevelness

machine_details.machine_type: Pressurized Vertical Spindle Package Dyeing Vessel

capacity.fabric_capacity: 200 kg yarn packages (approx 200 packages @ 1.0 kg each)

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: Cotton yarn packages, Polyester textured yarn, Wool cones, Acrylic yarn
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Disperse Dyes, Acid Dyes, Indanthrene Vat Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Salt, Soda Ash, Caustic, Hydros, Acetic Acid, Dispersing agents
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Yarn Package Bleaching, Dyeing, Soaping, Rewinding preparation

machine_constraints.minimum_load: 100 kg (Requires dummy packages on empty spindles to prevent bypass)
machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Differential pressure Delta P must stay between 0.8 and 1.5 bar
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Requires rigid perforated plastic or stainless steel spring dye tubes

performance.water_consumption: 40 to 55 Liters per kg of yarn
performance.steam_consumption: 3.0 to 4.0 kg steam per kg of yarn
performance.power_consumption: 22 kW main reversible centrifugal pump motor

sensors.pressure_sensor: Dual Differential Pressure Sensor (Spindle vs Vessel)

operating_parameters.recommended_pressure: Spindle Pressure 2.5 bar | Vessel Pressure 1.5 bar (Delta P 1.0 bar)
operating_parameters.recommended_speed: Reversal Cycle: 4 min In-Out / 2 min Out-In

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect spindle seals, check carrier locking nuts, clean main filter screen
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect reversal valve pneumatic cylinders, test safety relief valve
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate differential pressure transmitter, inspect carrier spindles for bowing
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Bi-annual calibration of flow meter and PT100 temperature sensors

failure_information.common_faults: Liquor bypass channel formation, package tube collapsing, flow reversal valve jamming
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Delta P < 0.5 bar (bypass), Delta P > 1.8 bar (clogging), Temp deviation
failure_information.failure_causes: Uneven winding density (<0.30 g/cm³), excessive column compaction pressure
failure_information.troubleshooting: Verify package winding density (0.35 ± 0.015 g/cm³); check spindle column torque

safety.safety_limits: Max temp 135°C, Max vessel pressure 4.5 bar, Safety valve set at 4.2 bar
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Delta P spike > 2.2 bar, pneumatic door seal pressure drop, main pump overload
safety.ppe_requirements: Safety glasses, heat resistant gloves, safety shoes, hard hat near overhead crane

machine_operating_rules: ASSERT package_density >= 0.32 AND package_density <= 0.38 FOR Cotton yarn
ASSERT package_density >= 0.38 AND package_density <= 0.42 FOR Polyester yarn
IF empty_spindles > 0 THEN dummy_blanking_tubes MUST BE INSTALLED
interlock_conditions: Flow reversal valve CANNOT actuate unless Main_Pump_RPM < 20% (prevents water hammer)
Door safety lock ENGAGED while Temperature > 80°C
best_operating_practices: Maintain 12-15% axial compaction when securing spindle locking nuts
Use expandable stainless spring tubes for polyester package dyeing to allow shrinkage

operating_limits.maximum_speed: 500 m/min fabric velocity via air stream

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: Sensitive knits, Lycra/Spandex blends, Tencel, Viscose, Microfiber PES
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Disperse Dyes, Acid Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Dyes, Salt, Soda Ash, Acetic Acid, Anti-foaming agents
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Ultra-low liquor exhaust dyeing, Scouring, Washing-off

machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Air injection blower operating pressure 0.6 bar
machine_constraints.chemical_restrictions: Silicon-free anti-foaming agent mandatory to prevent air lock
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Fabric weight must be > 80 GSM to prevent rope collapse inside air stream

performance.water_consumption: 25 to 35 Liters per kg of fabric (40% water savings vs soft-flow)
performance.steam_consumption: 1.8 to 2.4 kg steam per kg of fabric
performance.power_consumption: 30 kW high-pressure air blower + 15 kW liquor pump

sensors.flow_sensor: Air Velocity Meter (m/s) & Liquor Flow Meter

operating_parameters.recommended_speed: Air Velocity 35 m/s | Fabric Speed 350 m/min

maintenance.daily_checks: Clean air blower lint filter screen, inspect atomization nozzles
maintenance.weekly_checks: Check air blower belt and bearings, calibrate level sensor
maintenance.monthly_checks: Inspect heat exchanger for lint build-up, calibrate temp sensors
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Bi-annual air velocity sensor and temperature calibration

failure_information.common_faults: Air-lock due to excessive foam, lint clogging in air recirculation tube
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Air pressure drop < 0.3 bar, foam sensor trip, high turn time
failure_information.failure_causes: Omission of defoamer, high linting fabric without pre-singeing
failure_information.troubleshooting: Dose 1 g/L silicon-free defoamer; auto-flush air filter screen

safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Air blower failure, vessel overpressure, main door seal pressure loss
safety.ppe_requirements: Ear defenders (high blower noise), safety glasses, heat gloves

machine_operating_rules: IF foam_level > HIGH THEN AUTO_DOSE defoamer_g_per_l = 0.8
IF fabric_gsm < 80 THEN REJECT (rope collapse risk)
interlock_conditions: Liquor atomization spray CANNOT start unless Air_Blower_Status == RUNNING
decision_rules: REQUIRE silicon_free_defoamer >= 0.5 g/L FOR ALL RECIPES
best_operating_practices: Pre-dissolve defoamer in feed tank before introducing air stream
Run continuous air filter flushing cycle during high-speed heating phases

machine_details.machine_name: Atmospheric High Capacity Jigger Dyeing Machine
machine_details.machine_type: Constant Tension Constant Speed Open-Width Jigger

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: 100% Woven Cotton, Linen, Viscose, Silk, Heavy Canvas & Denim
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Direct Dyes, Vat Dyes, Sulfur Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Salt, Soda Ash, Caustic, Hydros, Sodium Sulfide

machine_constraints.temperature_restrictions: Max 98°C at sea level (Cannot dye 100% Polyester without carriers)
machine_constraints.chemical_restrictions: Corrosive acids must be diluted prior to trough addition
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Woven fabrics only (Strictly NO knit fabrics due to selvedge curling)

performance.water_consumption: 30 to 45 Liters per kg of fabric
performance.power_consumption: 15 kW DC drive motors with regenerative braking

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect main drive roller rubbers, check expander bar alignment
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect tension load cells, check hood door steam seals
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate warp tension load cells and temperature sensor

failure_information.common_faults: Selvedge curling, end-to-end shade variation, warp streakiness
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Tension limit exceeded (>500N), passage count error, hood open during 95°C
failure_information.failure_causes: Uneven winding tension between main rollers, speed variation
failure_information.troubleshooting: Zero load cell sensors; adjust bowing expander roller

safety.safety_limits: Max temp 98°C, Max roll diameter 1100 mm
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Emergency stop bar triggered by operator, roll overrun
safety.ppe_requirements: Safety glasses, heat gloves, chemical boots

machine_operating_rules: IF fabric_structure == 'Knit' THEN REJECT (selvedge curling hazard)
IF process == 'Vat_Dyeing' THEN closed_hood_steam_injection MUST BE ACTIVE
interlock_conditions: Main rollers CANNOT reverse direction unless Speed < 5 m/min
Steam valve closes if Enclosure_Hood is OPEN
best_operating_practices: Keep enclosure hood tightly closed during 95°C holds to prevent edge cooling and listing defects
Ensure equal number of passages (ends) are run for dye addition and washing phases

capacity.liquor_capacity: Pad Trough 15 to 25 Liters (Low volume anti-tailing trough)

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: 100% Woven Cotton, P/C Blends, Linen, Denim, Workwear Bottom-weights
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Vat Dyes, Reactive Dyes, Sulfur Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Caustic Soda, Sodium Hydrosulfite, Salt, Soda Ash, H2O2, Migration Inhibitors
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Continuous Pigment Padding, Chemical Reduction Steaming, Continuous Oxidation & Washing

machine_constraints.minimum_load: 1000 meters run to justify chemical pad trough setup
machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Pad mangle nip pressure 2.5 to 4.5 bar
machine_constraints.chemical_restrictions: Oxygen concentration inside steamer MUST be < 0.1% for Vat dyes
machine_constraints.liquor_ratio_limits: Padding Pick-up Expression 60% to 75% wet pick-up

performance.water_consumption: 15 to 25 Liters per kg of fabric (High efficiency counter-flow washers)
performance.steam_consumption: 1.5 to 2.2 kg steam per kg fabric
performance.power_consumption: 65 kW total multi-drive synchronized motor line

sensors.temperature_sensor: Multi-point Steamer PT100 Sensors & IR Fabric Temp Sensor
sensors.pressure_sensor: Pad Roller Nip Pneumatic Pressure Transmitters
sensors.flow_sensor: Chemical Dosing Flow Meters & Wash Box Water Meters

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect pad mangle rubber roll surfaces, check steamer water lock seals
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect swimming roller deflection pneumatic seals, test IR pre-dryer sensors
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate pad mangle nip pressure profile, calibrate steamer temp probes
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Semi-annual line synchronization and nip pressure calibration

failure_information.common_faults: Head-to-tail shade variation (tailing), center-to-selvedge shade variation, oxidation specks
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Steamer temp < 101°C, Steamer O2 > 0.2%, Pad trough level low, Line speed mismatch
failure_information.failure_causes: Trough liquor replacement time > 45s, pad roll deflection, steamer air ingress
failure_information.troubleshooting: Adjust trough volume displacement insert; re-crown swimming roll; seal steamer entry

safety.safety_limits: Max steamer temp 105°C, Max pad nip 5.0 bar, Emergency cord full line trip
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Emergency trip cord pulled along line, IR pre-dryer fire alarm, steamer lock failure
safety.ppe_requirements: Full face shield, chemical aprons, rubber boots, gas monitor for SO2

machine_operating_rules: IF dye_type == 'Vat' THEN steamer_o2_percent MUST BE < 0.1%
interlock_conditions: Chemical pad trough feed valve SHUTS OFF if Line_Speed < 5 m/min
IR Pre-dryer power CUT OFF automatically if Fabric_Motion_Sensor == STOPPED (fire prevention)
best_operating_practices: Maintain IR pre-dryer power to ensure fabric moisture drops to 25% before cylinder dryer contact
Use swimming roll pneumatic pressure control to maintain uniform nip pick-up across 1.8m width
